constraints_details.constraints_layer_description: CONARA Conservation Area: THE LAKES ESTATE
CILRES CIL ZONE: Higher Rate - RATE: £120 per square metre
DMDCA Designation: Conservation Area- Name: THE LAKES ESTATE- Policy: DMD 37-44- Core Strategy: Core policy 30-31

description: First floor rear extension, rear dormer with doors, balustrade and flank window.
decision_conditions: The proposed rear dormer extension by reason of its design, bulk, dimensions and siting would result in an unacceptable form of development that would be harmful to the established character of the application property, as well as the special character of the Lakes Estate Conservation Area. The proposal thereby fails to preserve and enhance the character and appearance of the Lakes Estate Conservation Area, contrary to the advice contained within the NPPF, London Plan policies D1, D4, D8 and HC1, Enfield Core Strategy policies CP30 and CP31, Enfield Development Management Document policies DMD8, DMD13, DMD37 and DMD44, The Lakes Estate Conservation Area Character Appraisal and The Lakes Estate Conservation Area Management Proposals.

The proposed first floor rear extension by reason of its design, siting and excessive scale, bulk and massing would result in a harmful and dominant form of development that is detrimental to the character and appearance of the application dwelling, surrounding area and the Lakes Estate Conservation Area. The proposals thereby fails to preserve and enhance the special character of the Lakes Estate Conservation Area, contrary to the advice contained within the NPPF, London Plan policies D1, D4, D8 and HC1, Enfield Core Strategy policies CP30 and CP31, Enfield Development Management Document policies DMD11, DMD37 and DMD44, The Lakes Estate Conservation Area Character Appraisal and The Lakes Estate Conservation Area Management Proposals.
